sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; PVDetector, Agentic Botnets, and complexity-aware execution were rejected as duplicate or already live, then Who Grades the Grader was selected from the same table.
Read arXiv abstract and HTML full text, including method setup, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-3, appendix artifacts, Goodhart repair, and limitations.
Article reconstructs metric grammar, Double Ratchet loop, objective function, pseudocode, held-out results, ablation table, and detector lifecycle evidence.
Review emphasized anchor quality, vacuous grader collapse, judge disagreement, Spider semantic limits, and reproducibility dependencies.
Markdown uses self-contained TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external image URLs are referenced.
